skills.description: Use when deciding what paths a specific agent is allowed to write inside an already-isolated workspace. NOT for isolating the task physically from the main repo (that is orbit-core-worktree-isolation) and NOT for the phase/gate mechanics around the agent call itself (that is orbit-core-phase-design).

Use when designing a new Phase (engineer/agent/code), Envelope, or Gate for an orbit-core pipeline. NOT for physical isolation of a task (that is orbit-core-worktree-isolation) and NOT for deciding what an agent may write (that is orbit-core-permissions-policy).

Use when a task needs to run in its own isolated copy of a git repo before any agent touches it. NOT for deciding what paths an agent may write once it's already isolated (that is orbit-core-permissions-policy) and NOT for designing the phases that run inside the worktree (that is orbit-core-phase-design).
